about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Saint Andrew the Apostle” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O Lord, we have received the divine sacrament on the joyful feast day of blessed Andrew the Apostle: as You make it contribute to the glory of Your saints, so, we beseech You, may it bring about our forgiveness. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
